scope: Full non-merge and separate-merge-parent Gitleaks CLI patch-history evidence through the frozen accepted root. This updates the accepted source-history workflow; it is not the provider-stopped release-provenance/security review or current security clearance.

policy.detector: Gitleaks 8.30.1 built-in default rules and built-in allowlists

external_driver_config_lookup.meaning: Expected empty local configuration lookup; not a scanner failure.

baseline_and_delta.mode: Two full scans; no delta-only scan. Prior evidence does not suppress scanner findings. The current 105 include the prior 95; full-scan counts are not additive.

coverage_sets.encoding: Full IDs sorted lexicographically, one per line, final LF. Lists freeze the exact set; no moving HEAD selector.

nonmerge.diagnostics: One expected findings-present warning; raw exit 1 preserved.

merges.diagnostics: No scanner errors or warnings; raw exit 0.

merge_parent_coverage.comparison_note: Only an optional single-LF log separator differs. All parent identities, tree identities and direct patch hashes match the existing supplement.
merge_parent_coverage.replay_role: Read-only Git command-output coverage check; not another Gitleaks invocation or full-snapshot scan.

triage.method: Read every candidate from its exact reachable evidence Git blob and reported line. Reconstruct the redacted scanner match privately and require one occurrence on that line and the same added line in the pinned non-merge patch stream. For each SHA-256 record, require a unique JSON leaf and equality to source bytes at the explicitly recorded reachable source revision. Recheck the cached upstream archive member and revision for its vendor record. For the public-key record, prove equality to the tracked Info.plist SUPublicEDKey field and inspect the exact tracked public-key consumer; no private signing material is accessed. Historical code is not executed.
triage.column_diagnostic_note: The first diagnostic compared raw scanner columns to blob columns and found a +1 offset for all 105. Those results remain in patch-bindings-summary.json. Including the single added-line + marker accounts for every reported column without changing raw locations or rerunning a scanner.
triage.public_key_note: The results.json:80 candidate at c1863689fa44a2ef002df1c8fffc4fed0d6b76d4 is not a SHA-256 record. It equals the tracked apps/macos/Support/Info.plist SUPublicEDKey field at that evidence revision, canonical base64 for 32 Ed25519 public bytes. The tracked updater consumes this public bundle field. No signing/private key, installed bundle or credential store was accessed.
triage.proof_value_policy: Candidate source hashes and public-key proof values are redacted only in committed reports. Exact proof values stay private. Git identities, paths, lines, JSON leaves and comparison results are retained. No raw scanner Match, Secret, identity, message, link or fingerprint fields are committed.

public_key_verification.method: Exact equality to the tracked Info.plist public bundle field, canonical 32-byte public encoding, and the tracked updater consumer. No signing/private key, installed bundle, credential store or network was accessed.

findings.classification: verified public Ed25519 verification key, not a credential or SHA-256 record
